name: Brain
whatItIs: The control centre of the body, made of billions of nerve cells.
whereItIs: Protected inside the skull at the top of your head.
whatItDoes: Thinking, memory, movement, emotions, and controlling automatic actions like breathing.

name: Heart
whatItIs: A strong muscle about the size of your fist.
whereItIs: In the middle of your chest, slightly to the left.
whatItDoes: Pumps blood around the body, carrying oxygen and nutrients to every cell.

name: Lungs
whatItIs: Two spongy organs that fill with air.
whereItIs: On either side of the heart inside the rib cage.
whatItDoes: Take in oxygen and remove carbon dioxide when you breathe.

name: Stomach
whereItIs: On the left side of the upper belly.
whatItDoes: Mixes food with acid and enzymes to start breaking it down.

name: Liver
whatItIs: The largest organ inside the body.
whereItIs: Under the ribs on the right side of the belly.
whatItDoes: Filters blood, stores energy, and helps digest food.

name: Kidneys
whereItIs: Toward the back, just below the rib cage on each side.
whatItDoes: Filter waste and extra water from blood to make urine.

name: Skeleton
whereItIs: Throughout the body, joined at the joints.
whatItDoes: Supports the body, protects organs, and helps you move.
